analysis.overall: You maintained fantastic time-in-range today overall, though a couple of meals brought noticeable late-morning and afternoon climbs that required careful correction.

events.title: Starting Low
events.description: You began the afternoon at 65 mg/dL before quickly stabilizing and preparing for lunch.

events.title: Evening Peak
events.description: Glucose climbed up to 186 mg/dL around dinner time, but responded well to temporary basals and correction boluses to bring it back down.

events.title: Overnight Dip
events.description: A brief dip down to 80 mg/dL occurred in the middle of the night before recovering nicely back into range.

events.title: Cheese Veg Sandwich
events.description: A 32g carb breakfast sandwich was followed by a steady climb up to around 147 mg/dL before leveling off.

events.title: Midday Spike
events.description: Following a 20g carb meal, glucose rose toward 185 mg/dL, prompting a few correction boluses to catch the upward trend.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on late-morning meal timing and carb counting, as both recent lunches caused quick climbs pushing toward 180 mg/dL.
